identity_change.behavior: Drop from root to the named fixture account UID 2000 and verify the resulting user ID.
identity_change.condition: evt.type=setuid and (known_user_in_container or not container) and not (user.name=root or user.uid=0) and not somebody_becoming_themselves and not proc.name in (known_setuid_binaries, userexec_binaries, mail_binaries, docker_binaries, nomachine_binaries) and not proc.name startswith "runc:" and not java_running_sdjagent and not nrpe_becoming_nagios and not user_known_non_sudo_setuid_conditions

interactive_recon.behavior: Launch a real, fixed reconnaissance utility under a pseudo-terminal and the required process-group-leader context; verify output.
interactive_recon.condition: spawned_process and recon_binaries_procs and proc.tty != 0 and proc.is_vpgid_leader=true

netcat_exec.rule: Netcat Remote Code Execution in Container
netcat_exec.behavior: Launch real ncat with the stock exec argument against an isolated peer; execute only a fixed marker command and verify receipt and child completion.
netcat_exec.condition: spawned_process and container and ((proc.name = "nc" and (proc.cmdline contains " -e" or proc.cmdline contains " -c")) or (proc.name = "ncat" and (proc.args contains "--sh-exec" or proc.args contains "--exec" or proc.args contains "-e " or proc.args contains "-c " or proc.args contains "--lua-exec")) )

bulk_clear.behavior: Launch a rule-listed clearing utility against an owned disposable file; verify the predeclared change without touching other data.
bulk_clear.condition: spawned_process and clear_data_procs and not user_known_remove_data_activities

ssh_nonstandard.rule: Disallowed SSH Connection Non Standard Port
ssh_nonstandard.behavior: Launch the real SSH client against a fixture sshd on a stock-listed port; use an isolated non-loopback address satisfying the rule network macros and verify a marker exchange.
ssh_nonstandard.condition: outbound and proc.exe endswith ssh and fd.l4proto=tcp and ssh_non_standard_ports_network

shell_network.behavior: Launch a fixed real shell performing a bounded TCP marker exchange with an isolated non-loopback peer; verify received bytes.
shell_network.condition: inbound_outbound and fd.sockfamily = ip and (system_procs or proc.name in (shell_binaries)) and not proc.name in (known_system_procs_network_activity_binaries) and not login_doing_dns_lookup and not user_expected_system_procs_network_activity_conditions

proxy_environment.rule: Program run with disallowed http proxy env
proxy_environment.behavior: Launch a real curl/wget client with a fixed HTTP_PROXY value and an isolated HTTP fixture; verify the operation separately from the process/environment predicate.
proxy_environment.condition: spawned_process and http_proxy_procs and proc.env icontains HTTP_PROXY and not allowed_ssh_proxy_env

network_tool.rule: Launch Suspicious Network Tool in Container
network_tool.behavior: Launch a real rule-listed networking tool to exchange marker bytes with an isolated peer.
network_tool.condition: spawned_process and container and network_tool_procs and not user_known_network_tool_activities

remote_copy.rule: Launch Remote File Copy Tools in Container
remote_copy.behavior: Launch a real rule-listed transfer utility against an isolated fixture service; verify transferred content.
remote_copy.condition: spawned_process and container and remote_file_copy_procs and not user_known_remote_file_copy_activities

ingress_copy.rule: Launch Ingress Remote File Copy Tools in Container
ingress_copy.behavior: Launch a real download utility with the stock download arguments and verify bytes written from an isolated HTTP fixture.
ingress_copy.condition: spawned_process and container and (ingress_remote_file_copy_procs or curl_download) and not user_known_ingress_remote_file_copy_activities

privileged_mount.behavior: Launch the real mount utility for a private container-owned fixture mount; verify its mount entry. Privileged status is fixed for active/control and all configurations; never mount host resources.
privileged_mount.condition: spawned_process and container and container.privileged=true and proc.name=mount and not mount_info and not known_gke_mount_in_privileged_containers and not known_aks_mount_in_privileged_containers and not known_eks_mount_in_privileged_containers and not user_known_mount_in_privileged_containers

privileged_debugfs.behavior: Launch real debugfs in read-only mode against a generated filesystem-image fixture; verify output. Use the identical privileged-container context for all configurations and controls.
privileged_debugfs.condition: spawned_process and container and container.privileged=true and proc.name=debugfs

k8s_client.rule: Kubernetes Client Tool Launched in Container
k8s_client.behavior: Launch the real Docker CLI with --version and verify its version output. Docker is explicitly listed by the unchanged rule; no daemon or Kubernetes cluster is needed.
k8s_client.condition: spawned_process and container and not user_known_k8s_client_container_parens and proc.name in (k8s_client_binaries)

protected_shell.behavior: A real isolated web server launches the native composite as a CGI executable; the composite launches a fixed shell marker command. Verify actual protected ancestry and rule exclusions.
protected_shell.condition: spawned_process and shell_procs and proc.pname exists and protected_shell_spawner and not proc.pname in (shell_binaries, gitlab_binaries, cron_binaries, user_known_shell_spawn_binaries, needrestart_binaries, mesos_shell_binaries, erl_child_setup, exechealthz, PM2, PassengerWatchd, c_rehash, svlogd, logrotate, hhvm, serf, lb-controller, nvidia-installe, runsv, statsite, erlexec, calico-node, "puma reactor") and not proc.cmdline in (known_shell_spawn_cmdlines) and not proc.aname in (unicorn_launche) and not consul_running_net_scripts and not consul_running_alert_checks and not nginx_starting_nginx and not nginx_running_aws_s3_cp and not run_by_package_mgmt_binaries and not serf_script and not check_process_status and not run_by_foreman and not python_mesos_marathon_scripting and not splunk_running_forwarder and not postgres_running_wal_e and not postgres_running_cnpg and not redis_running_prepost_scripts and not rabbitmq_running_scripts and not rabbitmqctl_running_scripts and not run_by_appdynamics and not user_shell_container_exclusions

web_shell.behavior: Under the same real web-server/CGI fixture, launch a fixed shell operation from the native program and verify output; retain the distinct exact target rule.
web_shell.condition: spawned_process and spawned_by_web_server and proc.name in (shell_binaries) and not proc.cmdline startswith "sh -c /usr/bin" and not proc.cmdline contains "healthcheck" and not user_known_web_server_shell_activities

web_child.rule: Web Server Spawned Suspicious Child Process
web_child.behavior: Under a real web-server/CGI fixture, launch a rule-listed non-shell child for a bounded local operation; verify its result.
web_child.condition: spawned_process and spawned_by_web_server and proc.name in (suspicious_web_children) and not proc.name in (shell_binaries) and not proc.cmdline contains "healthcheck" and not proc.cmdline contains "status" and not user_known_web_server_child_activities

web_reverse_shell.behavior: Under a real web-server/CGI fixture, launch the fixed shell with a matching command form and return a marker over an isolated connection. Hold helper bytes and arguments constant across configurations.
web_reverse_shell.condition: spawned_process and spawned_by_web_server and (proc.cmdline contains "/dev/tcp/" or proc.cmdline contains "nc -e" or proc.cmdline contains "ncat -e" or proc.cmdline contains "bash -i" or proc.cmdline contains "python -c 'import socket" or proc.cmdline contains "python3 -c 'import socket" or proc.cmdline contains "perl -e 'use Socket" or proc.cmdline contains "ruby -rsocket" or (proc.cmdline contains "mkfifo" and proc.cmdline contains "/tmp"))

npm_network_tool.rule: Network Tool Executed During NPM Package Install
npm_network_tool.behavior: A real Bun 1.3.0 local npm-package install lifecycle launches the native program after a FIFO capture gate. The program runs fixed ncat against a private peer and verifies the payload. Bun is explicitly listed by the unchanged rule.
npm_network_tool.condition: spawned_process and container and network_tool_procs and npm_package_install_ancestor and not user_known_network_tool_in_npm_install_activities

shell_config_read.behavior: Read a synthetic shell-configuration fixture using each language library and verify exact bytes.
shell_config_read.condition: open_read and (fd.filename in (shell_config_filenames) or fd.name in (shell_config_files) or fd.directory in (shell_config_directories)) and not proc.name in (shell_binaries)

hidden_file.behavior: Create and verify an owned hidden file at a path outside stock exclusions; freeze one operation across configurations.
hidden_file.condition: ((modify and evt.arg.newpath contains "/.") or (mkdir and evt.arg.path contains "/.") or (open_write and evt.arg.flags contains "O_CREAT" and fd.name contains "/." and not fd.name pmatch (exclude_hidden_directories))) and not user_known_create_hidden_file_activities and not exe_running_docker_save

executable_chmod.behavior: Add executable permission to an owned inert file and verify mode; do not execute it.
executable_chmod.condition: chmod and container and evt.rawres>=0 and ((evt.arg.mode contains "S_IXUSR") or (evt.arg.mode contains "S_IXGRP") or (evt.arg.mode contains "S_IXOTH")) and not runc_writing_exec_fifo and not runc_writing_var_lib_docker and not user_known_container_drift_activities

executable_create.behavior: Create an owned inert file with executable mode in the initial creation operation; verify permissions and the detector event interpretation.
executable_create.condition: evt.type in (open,openat,openat2,creat) and evt.rawres>=0 and evt.is_open_exec=true and container and not runc_writing_exec_fifo and not runc_writing_var_lib_docker and not user_known_container_drift_activities

nodeport_exchange.behavior: Exchange bytes on an isolated address at a port in 30000–32767, satisfying unchanged network predicates. This tests the port-based rule, not Kubernetes orchestration.
nodeport_exchange.condition: inbound_outbound and container and fd.sport >= 30000 and fd.sport <= 32767 and not nodeport_containers

miner_port_exchange.rule: Detect outbound connections to common miner pool ports
miner_port_exchange.behavior: Exchange and verify a fixed TCP marker at private fixture address 198.18.0.1:3333. Automated detector-host name resolution maps the stock miner-domain lists to this address; no public miner endpoint is contacted.

unexpected_inbound.behavior: Accept and verify marker traffic from an isolated fixture address outside the unchanged allowed-source lists; ensure controls skip the listening/accept operation.
unexpected_inbound.condition: inbound and not ((fd.cip in (allowed_inbound_source_ipaddrs)) or (fd.cnet in (allowed_inbound_source_networks)) or (fd.cip.name in (allowed_inbound_source_domains)))
